goal: Real-object chain SOURCE: a Franka picks a REAL YCB foam_brick and delivers it to a flat handoff tray (for a cross-Kit real-object chain via the YCB-aware relay).
thoughts: cont.230: built as a FLAT-delivery Franka SOURCE for cross-Kit composition chains. Per the cont.229 handoff-height rule, a flat receiver (Franka, picks ~0.775) needs a flat handoff; CP-CHAIN-FLAT delivers into a DEEP bin (bad handoff for a downstream pick). This template = CP-CHAIN-FLAT's proven Franka pick (+90deg orient, 0.40m front pick, CP-01 regime) but delivers to a flat Tray at [0,-0.4] (top 0.75) so the relayed cube rests at 0.775 = a pickable flat handoff. drop_target z=0.80 (gentle place ~5cm above the tray top, settles to 0.775 — a high bin-drop would bounce off an open tray). Validate: gate_one.py CP-CHAIN-FRANKA-SRC on a FRESH Kit (cube reaches Tray). Then chain_xkit_gate.py CP-CHAIN-FRANKA-SRC CP-CHAIN-FLAT = a 2-station Franka cross-Kit line.
code:
# Franka FLAT-tray SOURCE: picks a front cube -> delivers onto a flat handoff TRAY (not a deep bin),
# so a downstream flat-pick receiver can relay it cross-Kit. CP-01-proven Franka pick regime.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", prim_type="DomeLight")
set_attribute(prim_path="/World/DomeLight", attr_name="inputs:intensity", value=1000.0)

create_prim(prim_path="/World/Ground", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, -0.5], scale=[20, 20, 1])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Ground", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

set_physics_scene_config(config={"enable_gpu_dynamics": False, "broadphase_type": "MBP"})

# Work table: half-extents [0.6,0.9,0.375], centre [0,0,0.375] -> TOP z=0.75; covers pick(+y), base, tray(-y).
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Table", prim_type="Cube", position=[0, 0, 0.375], scale=[0.6, 0.9, 0.375])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Table", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# CP-01-PROVEN orientation: +90deg about Z so base +X = world +Y; pick 0.40m in FRONT = reachable regime.
robot_wizard(
    robot_name="franka_panda",
    dest_path="/World/Franka",
    position=[0, 0, 0.75],
    orientation=[0.7071068, 0, 0, 0.7071068],
)

# ONE workpiece, 0.40m IN FRONT (local +y) under the PickSensor.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Xform", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.80])
add_reference(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", reference_path="/mnt/shared_data/isaac-sim-assets-complete-5.0.0/Assets/Isaac/5.0/Isaac/Props/YCB/Axis_Aligned/061_foam_brick.usd")
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1/_61_foam_brick", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")
simplify_collision(prim_path="/World/Cube_1/_61_foam_brick", approximation="convexHull")
for api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI", "PhysicsCollisionAPI", "PhysicsMassAPI", "PhysxRigidBodyAPI"):
    apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", schema_name=api)
bulk_set_attribute(prim_paths=["/World/Cube_1"], attr="physxRigidBody:sleepThreshold", value=0.0)
apply_physics_material(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", material_name="rubber")

# FLAT handoff TRAY BEHIND the robot (local -y = base -X, the CP-01-proven place side). Cube edge 2m,
# scale -> half-extents [0.15,0.15,0.01], centre z=0.74 -> TOP z=0.75 -> the relayed cube rests at 0.775.
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Tray", prim_type="Cube", position=[0.0, -0.4, 0.74], scale=[0.15, 0.15, 0.01])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Tray", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

add_proximity_sensor(sensor_path="/World/PickSensor", position=[0.0, 0.4, 0.85], size=[0.08, 0.08, 0.14])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/Franka",
    target_source="curobo",
    sensor_path="/World/PickSensor",
    belt_path=None,
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1"],
    destination_path="/World/Tray",
    drop_target=[0.0, -0.4, 0.80],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Tray"],
)
